name: @fluxapay/react
description: React hooks for the FluxaPay SDK — payments, refunds, and merchant data for Next.js dashboards

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e "import { usePayment, useMerchant, useMerchantPayments, useRefund, useCreatePayment, useMerchantBalance, useStreamAccrual } from './dist/index.js'; for (const [name, fn] of Object.entries({ usePayment, useMerchant, useMerchantPayments, useRefund, useCreatePayment, useMerchantBalance, useStreamAccrual })) { if (typeof fn !== 'function') { throw new Error('Missing hook export: ' + name); } } console.log('All hooks exported correctly.');"
